name: MetalGarurumon (X Antibody)
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Unsuspend this Digimon, and it gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
 [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended, if [MetalGarurumon] or [X Antibody] is in its digivolution cards, return all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest level to their owner's hand.
